arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي يَوْمِ الْأَضْحَى وَ الْجُمُعَةِ
english_title: 48. His Supplication On the Day of Sacrifice and Friday

phrases.english: 1.O God, this is a blessed and fortunate day,

phrases.arabic: وَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِي أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ،
phrases.english: 2.within which the Muslims are gathered in the quarters of Your earth.

phrases.arabic: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ
phrases.english: 3.Among them are present the asker, the seeker, the beseecher, the fearful,
4.while You art looking upon their needs.

phrases.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
phrases.english: 5.So I ask You by Your munificence and generosity and easy upon You is what I ask You!

phrases.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
phrases.english: 6.- that You blessest Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ،
phrases.english: 7.And I ask You, O God, our Lord -for Thine is the kingdom and Thine is the praise

phrases.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ
phrases.english: 8.there is no god but Thou,the Clement, the Generous,the All-loving, the All-kind,

phrases.arabic: ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ،
phrases.english: 9.Possessor of majesty and munificence,Originator of the heavens and the earth
10.whenever You apportionest among Your faithful servants

phrases.arabic: مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ
phrases.english: 11.good, well being, blessing, guidance, works in obedience to You,

phrases.arabic: ،أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ
phrases.english: 12.or good through which You art kind to them by guiding them to You,
13.or raisest them up a degree with You,

phrases.arabic: ، أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
phrases.english: 14.or givest them the good of this world or the next,
15.that You givest me amply my share and allotment of it.
16.And I ask You, O God -
17.for Thine is the kingdom and the praise;
18.there is no god but You -
19.that You blessest Muhammad
20.Your servant and Your messenger,
21.Your beloved and Your selected friend,
22.Your chosen from among Your creation,

phrases.arabic: وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ
phrases.english: 23.and the Household of Muhammad, the pious, the pure, the chosen,

phrases.arabic: ,صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
phrases.english: 24.with a blessing no one has strength to count but Thou,
25.that You associatest us with

phrases.arabic: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ  فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
phrases.english: 26.the most righteous of those who supplicate You today
27.of Your faithful servants
28.- O Lord of the worlds!—
29.and that You forgivest us and them!
30."Surely You art powerful over everything" (3:26).
31.O God, toward You I aim with my need
32.and before You today I set my poverty,
33.my neediness, my misery,

phrases.arabic: وَ إِنِّي بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ  أَوْثَقُ مِنِّي بِعَمَلِي
phrases.english: 34.for I have more trust in Your forgiveness and Your mercy than in my own works.

phrases.arabic: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
phrases.english: 35.Your forgiveness and Your mercy are vaster than my sins.

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
phrases.english: 36.So bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

phrases.arabic: ، وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي
phrases.english: 37.and attend to the accomplishment of every need of mine through
38.Your power over it,
39.its easiness for You,
40.my poverty toward You,
41.and Your freedom from need for me!

phrases.arabic: ، فَإِنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ
phrases.english: 42.I will come upon no good whatsoever unless through You,

phrases.arabic: ، وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ
phrases.english: 43.no one other than You will turn any evil away from me,
44.and I have hope in none but You for my affair
45.in the next world and in this world.
46.O God, if anyone has ever arranged, made ready,
47.prepared, and drawn himself up
48.to be received by a creature

phrases.arabic: رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
phrases.english: 49.in hope of his support and awards,
50.then today toward You, my Master,
51.is my arrangement, my making ready,
52.my preparation, and my drawing up
53.in hope of Your pardon and support
54.and in seeking to attain to You and Your prize.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
phrases.english: 55.O God, so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

phrases.arabic: وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي،
phrases.english: 56.and disappoint not my hope in that today!
57.O He who is not troubled by those who ask
58.and diminished by those who attain their desire!
59.I come not before You trusting
60.in a righteous work I have sent ahead,
61.nor in the intercession of any creature in whom I have hope,

phrases.arabic: إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
phrases.english: 62.except the intercession of Muhammad and the Folk of his House
63.(upon him and upon them be Your peace).

phrases.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
phrases.english: 64.I come to You admitting sin and evildoing toward myself.
65.I come to You hoping for Your abounding pardon
66.through which You hast pardoned the offenders,

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ
phrases.english: 67.while their long persistence in dreadful sin did not prevent You

phrases.arabic: أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
phrases.english: 68.from returning toward them with mercy and forgiveness!
69.O He whose mercy is wide
70.and whose pardon is abounding!
71.O All-mighty! O All-mighty!
72.O All-generous! O All-generous!

phrases.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
phrases.english: 73.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
74.return toward me through Your mercy,
75.be tender toward me through Your bounty,
76.and spread out Your forgiveness upon me!

phrases.arabic: . اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ
phrases.english: 77.O God, this station belongs to Your vicegerents, Your chosen,
78.while the places of Your trusted ones

phrases.arabic: فِي الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا
phrases.english: 79.in the elevated degree which You hast singled out for them
80.have been forcibly stripped!
81.But You art the Ordainer of that -
82.Your command is not overcome,

phrases.arabic: وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
phrases.english: 83.the inevitable in Your governing is not overstepped!
84.However You willest and whenever You willest!
85.In that which You knowest best,

phrases.arabic: غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
phrases.english: 86.Thou art not accused for Your creation or Your will!
87.Then Your selected friends, Your vicegerents,
88.were overcome, vanquished, forcibly stripped;
89.they see Your decree replaced,
90.Your Book discarded,

phrases.arabic: ، وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ
phrases.english: 91.Your obligations distorted from the aims of Your laws,
92.and the Sunna of Your Prophet abandoned!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
phrases.english: 93.O God, curse their enemies among those of old and the later folk,
94.and all those pleased with their acts,
95.and their adherents and followers!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
phrases.english: 96.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
97.(surely You art All-laudable, All-glorious)
98.like Your blessing, benedictions, and salutations

phrases.arabic: عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
phrases.english: 99.upon Your chosen Abraham and the people of Abraham!
100.And hasten for them relief,

phrases.arabic: وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
phrases.english: 101.ease, help, strengthening,and confirmation!
102.O God, and make me
103.one of the people who profess Your Unity,
104.have faith in You,
105.and attest to Your Messenger
106.and the Imams toward whom You hast enjoined obedience,

phrases.arabic: مِمَّنْ يَجْرِي ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
phrases.english: 107.and one of those through whom and at whose hands this takes place!
108.Amen, Lord of the worlds!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ
phrases.english: 109.O God, nothing repels Your wrath but Your clemency,

phrases.arabic: ، وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ
phrases.english: 110.nothing repels Your displeasure but Your pardon,

phrases.arabic: وَ لا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ
phrases.english: 111.nothing grants sanctuary from Your punishment but Your mercy,
112.and nothing will deliver me from You

phrases.arabic: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
phrases.english: 113.except pleading to You before You,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
phrases.english: 114.so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

phrases.arabic: وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجاً
phrases.english: 115.and give us on Your part, my God, relief
116.by means of the power through which You bringest the dead servants to life
117.and revivest the dead lands.

phrases.arabic: . وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِي يَا إِلَهِي غَمّاً
phrases.english: 118.Destroy me not through gloom, my God,
119.before You respondest to me
120.and givest me the knowledge of Your response to my supplication!

phrases.arabic: وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
phrases.english: 121.Let me taste the flavour of well-being to the end of my term!
122.And let not my enemy gloat over me,
123.place not my neck in his power,
124.and give him not authority over me!
125.My God, if You raisest me up,
126.who is there to push me down?
127.If You pushest me down,
128.who is there to raise me up?
129.If You honourest me,
130.who is there to humiliate me?
131.If You humiliatest me,
132.who is there to honour me?
133.If You chastisest me,
134.who is there to have mercy upon me?
135.If You destroyest me,

phrases.arabic: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
phrases.english: 136.who is there to stand up for Your servant against You
137.or ask You about his affair?

phrases.arabic: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
phrases.english: 138.But I know that there is no wrong in Your decree
139.and no hurry in Your vengeance.

phrases.arabic: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
phrases.english: 140.He alone hurries who fears to miss,

phrases.arabic: وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
phrases.english: 141.and only the weak needs to wrong.
142.But You art exalted, my God,
143.high indeed above all that!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
phrases.english: 144.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
145.make me not the target of affliction
146.nor the object of Your vengeance,
147.respite me, comfort me,
148.release me from my stumble,
149.and afflict me not with an affliction
150.in the wake of an affliction,
151.for You hast seen my frailty,
152.the paucity of my stratagems,
153.and my pleading to You!

phrases.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
phrases.english: 154.I seek refuge in You today, my God, from Your wrath,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ  وَ أَعِذْنِي.
phrases.english: 155.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me refuge!

phrases.arabic: ، وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
phrases.english: 156.I seek sanctuary in You today from Your displeasure,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَجِرْنِي
phrases.english: 157.so bless Muhammad and his Household, and give me sanctuary!
158.I ask You security from Your chastisement,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ آمِنِّي
phrases.english: 159.so bless Muhammad and his Household, and give me security!
160.I seek guidance from You,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنِي
phrases.english: 161.so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide me!
162.I seek help from You,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ انْصُرْنِي
phrases.english: 163.so bless Muhammad and his Household and help me!
164.I ask You for mercy,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْحَمْنِي
phrases.english: 165.so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!
166.I seek sufficiency from You,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اكْفِنِي
phrases.english: 167.so bless Muhammad and his Household and suffice me!
168.I seek provision from You,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْزُقْنِي
phrases.english: 169.so bless Muhammad and his Household and provide for me!
170.I seek assistance from You,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِنِّي
phrases.english: 171.so bless Muhammad and his Household and assist me!

phrases.arabic: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
phrases.english: 172.I pray forgiveness for my past sins,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
phrases.english: 173.so bless Muhammad and his Household and forgive me!
174.I ask You to preserve me from sin,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اعْصِمْنِي
phrases.english: 175.so bless Muhammad and his Household and preserve me,

phrases.arabic: فَإِنِّي لَنْ أَعُودَ لِشَيْ‏ءٍ كَرِهْتَهُ مِنِّي إِنْ شِئْتَ ذَلِكَ
phrases.english: 176.for I will not return to anything You dislikest from me, if You willest that!

phrases.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
phrases.english: 177.My Lord! My Lord! O All-loving! O All-kind!
178.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
179.Bless Muhammad and his Household,
180.and grant me everything
181.that I ask from You, seek from You,
182.and beseech from You!

phrases.arabic: وَ أَرِدْهُ وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ اقْضِهِ وَ أَمْضِهِ
phrases.english: 183.Will it, ordain it, decree it, and accomplish it!

phrases.arabic: وَ خِرْ لِي فِيمَا تَقْضِي مِنْه
phrases.english: 184.Give me good in that of it which You decreest!
185.Bless me in that,
186.be gratuitously bountiful toward me through it,
187.make me happy in that of it which You givest to me,
188.and increase me in Your bounty
189.and the plenty of what is with You,
190.for You art Boundless, Generous!

phrases.arabic: وَ صِلْ ذَلِكَ بِخَيْرِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ نَعِيمِهَا
phrases.english: 191.And link that to the good and the bliss of the next world,
192.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

phrases.arabic: تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ، وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
phrases.english: 193.Then you supplicate as seems proper to you and you call down blessings on Muhammed and his Household one thousand times. this is what he used to do (upon him be peace).
